images.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: independent premium smartphone campaign image, landscape 1536x1024.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole product identity reference. Preserve the EXACT fictional phone: ice-blue brushed titanium back, straight flat edges with softly rounded corners, rounded-square camera island at top left, three large black lenses at upper left/lower left/right middle, small white flash upper right and black sensor lower right, no brand. Do not redesign the product.
Primary request: Create an ambitious surreal city photography advertisement with this identical phone, a big visual idea and cinematic scale, not an ordinary tabletop product shot.
Scene/backdrop: A spectacular invented city at sunset built from sculptural optical-glass towers and brushed-silver facades. One enormous upright phone floats just above a circular mirror plinth over a shallow reflective urban pool, back toward camera in three-quarter view. City buildings unfold upward and outward behind it like a miniature architectural world becoming full-size; use one sweeping translucent glass arc, layered bridges, angular reflecting planes, ripples and a few misty clouds between the buildings. The city is richly designed but clear: foreground glass and water, midground monumental phone, distant airy skyline and warm sun.
Composition/framing: phone slightly right of center, occupies 58 percent image height, all phone corners visible; dramatic low viewpoint and clear silhouette, strong diagonal city perspective leads toward phone. The camera island must read clearly, no buildings on top of the phone itself, no props covering its back. Immersive wide composition with breathing room, hierarchy rather than clutter.
Style/medium: exceptional luxury technology campaign, photoreal product photography composited with physically convincing surreal architecture, detailed optical reflections, not flat illustration or generic sci-fi wallpaper.
Lighting/mood: icy cyan and cobalt shadows against luminous peach-amber sunset, grazing silver rim light, rich but controlled highlights, subtle volumetric atmosphere, refined editorial color grading.
Text: none.
Constraints: one phone only; no logos, text, typography, captions, UI, watermark, people, laptops or office desks. Preserve camera number, triangle positions and body identity from reference. No mundane pedestal on plain gradient background.

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: cinematic creator-led smartphone video keyframe, landscape 1536x1024, a SINGLE photographic frame, not a storyboard grid and not a real video.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole phone product identity reference. Preserve EXACT fictional ice-blue brushed titanium phone, flat straight frame with soft corners, rounded-square island upper left, three large black lenses arranged left top / left bottom / right middle, white flash upper right and small black sensor lower right. No logo, no text. Show its rear clearly.
Primary request: A confident fictional adult East Asian female fashion/technology creator, about 28 years old, presenting this phone in an extraordinary designed advertising set. Editorial charisma, natural engaged slight smile, believable skin texture and human proportions. Shoulder-length glossy dark hair tucked behind one ear, sculptural silver ear cuff, crisp pale ice-blue overshirt over a charcoal fitted top, modern understated fashion. She holds one phone vertically in her right hand at shoulder/chest level near her face; rear faces camera clearly, fingers naturally along edges and lower body without covering lenses. Her other hand rests relaxed on a low reflective curved console.
Scene/backdrop: A grand roof-top photography studio opening into an amber sunset city skyline; asymmetric cobalt architectural wall panels, one monumental brushed-silver circular aperture behind and offset from the person, a tall angled mirror panel and a low translucent blue glass block in the far right foreground. Sophisticated set design with staggered depth, blue and orange light reflections on polished surfaces. A slim studio light fixture far right may suggest professional production, subtle and unbranded. Rich spatial scene, not a home office or ordinary desk.
Composition/framing: Person and visible phone together occupy middle-right half; her face around x=66% and phone around x=54%. Full head and all hair inside image with at least 10 percent top margin, medium waist-up framing, entire phone visible. Leftmost 25 percent is a quiet dark cobalt wall with softly graded light and restrained architectural shadow, reserved for live HTML text; no objects or human limbs there. Strong depth from foreground set pieces and distant city. Never crop head, phone, fingers.
Lighting/mood: premium global technology commercial, 50mm portrait photography, skin lit by a soft neutral key, blue cool ambient environment plus warm amber rim and practical reflections, cinematic contrast without neon overkill, natural skin, rich silver and cobalt with restrained orange.
Constraints: single person, exactly one physical phone, plausible five-finger hands, no duplicated reflection of person or phone in mirror, no image text, logos, captions, play buttons, UI, watermark, speech balloons. No tumbler, laptop, potted plants, generic home decor. No resemblance to the site's Lingling character. This is an elegant premium campaign still with a human presenter, not a cartoon.
